meta.title: Christmas gift vouchers for cooking classes in Madrid
meta.description: Give an Asian cooking class in Madrid this Christmas. Vouchers from €25, emailed on Christmas morning or posted as a printed card.

hero.title: Gift an <mark>experience</mark>, not a thing.
hero.sub: A three-hour Asian cooking class at our school in central Madrid, then dinner at the table. Gift vouchers from {price}.
hero.treeAlt: A Christmas tree hung with red paper lanterns

scene.title: Four ways to give a class
scene.sub: Pick one to make it yours.

formats.title: By email or printed. You choose.

digital.title: In their inbox on Christmas morning.
digital.text: Choose 25 December as the send date and it arrives at 9:00. Or send it straight away, or on any day in the next 30.
digital.textLater: From 25 November you can choose 25 December as the send date, and it arrives at 9:00 (Madrid time). Or send it straight away.
digital.pdf: A PDF to print or forward
digital.notification: You've been given a cooking class

printed.text: We print the voucher and post it in an envelope to any address in Spain. Printing and postage: {fee}.
printed.bow: Ready to wrap or put under the tree
printed.postBy: Order by {date} for it to arrive before Christmas.
printed.late: Printed cards ordered now arrive after Christmas. Choose email for Christmas morning.

includes.title: What a class includes
includes.welcome: A welcome drink when they arrive
includes.ingredients: All the ingredients, tools and an apron
includes.cooking: Two and a half hours at the wok, with a head chef and an assistant
includes.dinner: Dinner at the table, with a glass of wine or beer
includes.leftovers: Containers to take any leftovers home
includes.note: Up to 6 people a class. Over-16s can come on their own; younger cooks come with an adult.
includes.photoAlt: Vegetables cooking in a wok over the flame

builder.title: Make it yours
builder.sub: Choose the amount, write their name and your message, and decide how it arrives. The preview is exactly what they get.

send.title: Send
send.text: By email, or by post in an envelope.

cook.title: They cook
cook.text: They book a date within 12 months and put on the apron.

team.title: Gifts for your team?
team.text: Vouchers for staff and clients, or a private class for the whole team.

redeem.q: How do they use the voucher?
redeem.a: They choose a class and a date on woklab.es and enter the voucher code at checkout.

valid.a: 12 months from the day you buy it.

difference.q: What if the class costs more than the voucher?
difference.a: They pay the difference at checkout. A class is €89 a person.

preview.q: Can I see the voucher before I pay?
preview.a: Yes. The preview above changes as you type the names and your message.

otherDay.q: Can it arrive on another day?
otherDay.a: Yes. Pick any day in the next 30 days and it arrives at 9:00 (Madrid time). Or tick that you'll give it yourself, and we email the PDF to you.

close.title: Happy holidays
close.text: From all of us at Wok Lab.
